hook.en: An osteopathic method that moves the tissue into ease, adds a small compression, then guides it through the restriction.
hook.ur: Still technique mein pehle tissue ko ease ki direction mein le jate hain, phir gentle compression ya traction add karke restricted direction mein guide karte hain.

goal.en: By the end, you'll know what Still Technique is, when it's safe and useful, how to apply it step by step — and how to prove it worked. (4 checks along the way.)
goal.ur: End tak aap jaan jayenge ke Still Technique kya hai, kab safe aur faida-mand hai, qadam ba qadam kaise apply hoti hai — aur kaise prove karein ke kaam kiya. (Raste mein 4 checks.)

text.en: Still technique is a combined approach: you first move the tissue toward its position of ease (indirect), then add gentle compression or traction, and then guide it through the restricted direction (direct). It aims to reduce tension without a fast thrust.
text.ur: Yeh combined approach pehle indirect position of ease, phir gentle compression/traction, aur aakhir mein direct direction mein restricted movement ko guide karti hai. Maqsad fast thrust ke baghair tension kam karna hai.

simpler.en: An osteopathic method that moves the tissue into ease, adds a small compression, then guides it through the restriction.
simpler.ur: Still technique mein pehle tissue ko ease ki direction mein le jate hain, phir gentle compression ya traction add karke restricted direction mein guide karte hain.

text.en: Like loosening a stiff zipper: you first ease the fabric, then guide the slider along rather than tugging.
text.ur: Stiff zipper ko pehle kapray ko ease de kar phir slider ko guide karne jaisa; zor se kheenchna maqsad nahi. Yeh sirf analogy hai.

text.en:
Three ideas carry this whole technique:
**1.** Indirect first, then direct. The first move reduces guarding.
**2.** A small, steady force is maintained during the movement.
**3.** The aim is a smooth movement, not a forceful stretch.
text.ur: Pehle indirect, phir direct; pehli position guarding kam karne ke liye hoti hai. Movement ke dauran halki steady force rehti hai. Somatic dysfunction osteopathic term hai impaired body-region movement ke liye. Indirect ka matlab easy direction; direct ka matlab restriction ki taraf; facilitating force gentle compression ya traction hai.

text.en:
So when does **Still Technique** make sense?
• Stiff, tender joints or regions where a gentle method is wanted.
• Practitioners trained in osteopathic techniques.
text.ur: Stiff ya tender joint/region mein jab gentle method chahiye aur practitioner osteopathic technique mein trained ho. Fracture, instability, infection, blood-vessel concerns, ya technique ke dauran barhte pain/neurological symptoms mein nahi.

text.en:
And just as important — when you should NOT use it, or should stop:
• Fractures, instability, infection or blood-vessel concerns.
• Pain or neurological symptoms increasing during the technique.
**Stop rule:** Avoid manipulation with vascular red flags, new neurologic deficit, suspected myelopathy, cervical instability, infection or recent trauma.
text.ur: Forceful movement, patient comfort ignore karna aur post-treatment change ko permanent structural correction kehna avoid karein. Relevant contraindications screen karein aur symptoms ya function ko before/after retest karein.

title.en: How to do it — 5 steps, each with its reason
title.ur: Kaise karein — 5 qadam, har ek ki wajah ke saath

steps.title: Find the restriction
steps.detail: Palpate and test the stiff movement.

steps.title: Guide toward the barrier
steps.detail: Slowly move through the restricted direction while keeping the force.

steps.title: Return and retest
steps.detail: Return to neutral and retest movement.

beats.ur:
1. Restriction palpate aur test karein.
2. Region ko easiest direction mein position karein.
3. Gentle compression ya traction add karein.
4. Force maintain karte hue restricted direction mein ahista guide karein.
5. Neutral par wapas aakar movement retest karein.

beats.patient: Priyanka, 33, stiff neck after sleeping badly; rotation to the left is limited.
beats.assessment: No red flags; tenderness at the left neck muscles.
beats.treatment: You ease the head toward comfort, add light traction, and gently guide the head toward left rotation.
beats.reassess: Rotation improves and discomfort reduces. You advise gentle neck movement.
beats.ur:
Ek misal se poora clinical flow dekhein:
Source mein Priyanka, 33 saal ki, buri neend ke baad stiff neck rakhti hain aur left rotation limited hai. Red flags nahi aur left neck muscles tender hain. Head ko comfort ki taraf rakh kar light traction aur phir gentle left rotation guide ki jati hai; rotation behtar aur discomfort kam hota hai. Yeh teaching scenario hai.

text.en:
The mistakes I see most often:
• Skipping the ease step.
• Using force to push through guarding.
• Ignoring neck safety screening.
**Myth to drop:** 'A click means the vertebra went back.' Joint noises are not evidence of anatomical repositioning.
text.ur: Ease step skip karna, guarding ke through force lagana, ya neck safety screening bhoolna. Indirect then direct ka matlab? Pehle ease, phir restriction ki taraf guide. Force? Halki.

text.en:
Evidence is limited, mainly case reports and small studies. Results may reflect general effects of gentle manual therapy.
Still technique is established as a named historical osteopathic method; clinical outcome claims specific to the maneuver are not robustly established.
text.ur: Pehle ease, phir guide, phir retest. Evidence limited hai, zyada tar case reports aur chhoti studies; results gentle manual therapy ke general effects se bhi ho sakte hain.
